title: Weather Radar Transceiver — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Independent Position Determining — Weather Radar Transceiver

abstract: Installation of the weather radar transceiver on the radome bulkhead tray with the shim setting, the bonding check and the ground functional test that close the task on both radar standards.

sections.purpose: To install the weather radar transceiver on the radome bulkhead tray and to prove the installation with a ground functional test.
sections.job_setup_note: The radome must be open and supported. The aircraft must be de-powered for the mechanical work and on external power for the test. The area ahead of the radome must be clear for a radius of fifteen metres before the radar is selected. Two persons are needed and the radar test set must be available.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the electrical power is removed and that the warning notices are in position. Clean the tray mounting faces and examine them for corrosion. Build the shim stack to the value recorded at removal, or to the value in the acceptance table for a new unit. Put the transceiver D3440119270001 on the tray and install the four mounting bolts with washers AES311855K5 and AGS393059-2A. Torque the bolts to 11 Nm in a diagonal sequence. CAUTION: DO NOT TORQUE THE MOUNTING BOLTS BEFORE THE SHIM STACK IS COMPLETE. THE TRAY WILL DISTORT AND THE ANTENNA BORESIGHT WILL BE OUT OF LIMITS. Connect the waveguide at the transceiver flange, using a new gasket, and torque the flange bolts evenly. Connect the two electrical connectors and lock them. Do a bonding resistance check between the unit case and the tray and make sure that the value is below the limit. Restore the electrical power. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AREA AHEAD OF THE RADOME IS CLEAR FOR FIFTEEN METRES BEFORE THE RADAR IS SELECTED. Do the ground functional test with the radar test set and record the transmitted power and the receiver sensitivity. Do the display bus check at the control panel and confirm that the picture is drawn on both displays. Close and latch the radome.
sections.close_out: Remove the radar test set and the radome support strut. Make sure that every radome latch is fully engaged and that the latch witness marks line up. Make sure that no tools remain inside the radome. Remove the warning notices and the safety barriers. Record the installation, the serial number, the shim stack and the test results.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The software load step applies only to aircraft post MOD-111263.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the area ahead of the radome is clear for fifteen metres before the radar is selected.
Install the radome support strut before any work inside the radome.
Put the safety barriers in position around the nose.
